system.description:
Run Away. Enemies get no Attack Actions when you Escape a Brawl. A Move Action straight away from an enemy you're Brawling makes your Speed Fast until your Combat Turn ends.

Weak (Flaw). While wearing armour, your Speed is Slow.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.85

If your Move Action takes you directly away from an enemy you're Brawling, your Speed is Fast (40 ft) until the end of your Combat Turn.
